newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST BOURSE LAUNCHES CROSS TRADES.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST BOURSE LAUNCHES CROSS TRADES.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Wednesday it would introduce cross deals starting with its second weekly session on Thursday, in order to diversify trading.
Trades of the cross type, allowing a broker to act for both the buyer and the seller of a security in the same deal, will help further boost turnover, a bourse statement said.
To protect investors, cross transactions can be made within the spread between the best bid and the best ask, with a variation of plus/minus 10 percent at the most, it said.
Traders welcomed the move saying it was expected to increase the speed of trading and boost volumes.
Bucharest bourse activity, which has been sluggish for the most part of 1996, picked up this year, with the market in a bullish mood since early Janaury.
Prices have been on the rise for the past five sessions and turnover climbed to 158 million lei on Tuesday from 70 million at this year's first trading session on January 7.
